ai_summary: Ashika Global Securities Limited is notifying shareholders about the deduction of tax at source (TDS) on the recommended dividend of Re. 0.50 per share for FY 2025-26, requiring shareholders to update KYC details and submit tax exemption documents to avoid higher withholding rates (10-20%). A critical deadline of September 12, 2026, is set for all submissions, after which no tax determination requests will be considered, materially impacting shareholders who miss it with increased TDS. A significant red flag is the document's contradictory instructions regarding acceptable submission methods for tax relief documents, potentially confusing shareholders and leading to valid claims being rejected.
